title: EMDB deposition manifest
description: Structural schema for depositions/<slug>/manifest.json, enforced by em_deposit.py before any onedep_lib session is opened. Covers types, required fields, and array shape only. Value semantics the schema cannot express are checked separately after this passes: experiment_type/country/em_subtype/file_type are resolved case-insensitively to onedep_lib enums; em_subtype is required (and voxel/MRC checks apply) only for EM experiments; ORCID and email formats are checked; voxel values are checked for finiteness (JSON's number type accepts NaN/Infinity for floats). The tool writes session_id/remote_dep_id/site_url/file_id itself, so additional properties are permitted.

experiment_type.description: onedep_lib ExperimentType: EM (default if omitted), XRAY, NMR, SSNMR, NEUTRON, FIBER, EC. Resolved case-insensitively.

em_subtype.description: Required for EM experiments only (enforced semantically): SPA, HELICAL, SUBTOMOGRAM, TOMOGRAPHY.

coordinates.description: true only if a coordinates file is included. Must be a JSON boolean - the string "false" is rejected, not coerced.

related_emdb.description: Optional. EMD-XXXXX accessions this entry is related to (composite/consensus/focused-refinement workflow). onedep_lib has no cross-referencing API, so these are informational: preview/submit remind you to link them in the OneDep web UI.

voxel.description: Voxel spacing and contour. Sub-field presence and numeric sanity are enforced semantically (only for map-like file types), not here, so this stays a permissive object.
